value.behaviour: Subscribes useRouteRef to optional routeResolutionApi updates and invalidates memoized route resolution when the route resolver is re-initialized.
rules: 1. Import useEffect, useMemo, and useState from 'react', and RouteResolutionApi alongside RouteFunc, routeResolutionApiRef, and useApi from '../apis'.

2. Define an internal helper type SubscribableRouteResolutionApi = RouteResolutionApi & { subscribe?(listener: () => void): () => void; } so the public RouteResolutionApi interface gains no required members.
3. In useRouteRef, cast useApi(routeResolutionApiRef) to SubscribableRouteResolutionApi and maintain const [version, setVersion] = useState(0);.
4. Register a subscription in useEffect(() => routeResolutionApi.subscribe?.(() => { setVersion(v => v + 1); }), [routeResolutionApi]).

5. Include version in the useMemo dependency array ([routeResolutionApi, routeRef, pathname, version]) so routeResolutionApi.resolve(routeRef, { sourcePath: pathname }) recomputes whenever version increments, without calling resolve inside useEffect.

sites.first_line: When using phased app preparation, `app/root.children` acts as the main session boundary. Conditional extensions behind that boundary are evaluated during finalization. Conditional `app/root.elements` and API branches are also deferred until finalization, while other bootstrap-visible predicates are ignored and reported as warnings.
sites.last_line: Utility APIs that are first materialized during bootstrap are frozen for the lifetime of that app instance. Finalization may still add new APIs and may override existing API refs that were not materialized during bootstrap, but any deferred override of an already materialized bootstrap API is ignored and reported as an app error.
